topic: Why Does Rushing Rob You of the Very Thing You're Rushing Toward?

slides.text: Why does rushing rob you of the very thing you're rushing toward?
In a hurry, you can't actually *see* anything clearly.
The rush isn't really about time. It's a feeling of never having enough.
Slowing down isn't laziness - it's just being awake.
Being awake, you can't help but move well.
slides.cta: Notice the rush before you act on it.
